claim: Publish Sourcey docs for a second ecosystem
summary: Validated a live Sourcey-generated documentation site for moxygen, a maintained MIT-licensed TypeScript/Node.js npm CLI and library, pinned to sourcey/moxygen commit 2f14cd8354247e27553ee0d8f4139d5095234e16 with public runx receipt evidence.

target.name: moxygen
target.ecosystem: TypeScript / Node.js npm CLI and documentation tooling

sourcey.adapter: Sourcey markdown site using sourcey defineConfig(), markdown() navigation groups, GitHub edit links, and static generated pages.
sourcey.command_or_config: docs/package.json defines site:build as `sourcey build -o ../dist`; docs/sourcey.config.ts sets repo, editBranch, editBasePath, navigation groups, GitHub/npm navbar links, and prettyUrls strip.
sourcey.durable_host: 0state.com/moxygen/docs, linked from the moxygen product page and Sourcey examples; not a personal github.io throwaway host.

validation.runx_command: npx -y @runxhq/cli@0.6.15 skill work/sourcey-moxygen-validation-skill check --input-json urls=[...] -i repo_url=https://github.com/sourcey/moxygen -i commit=2f14cd8354247e27553ee0d8f4139d5095234e16 -i license=MIT -i ecosystem=TypeScript / Node.js documentation tooling -i runx_version=runx-cli 0.6.15 -R work/runx-receipts/sourcey-moxygen-wsl2 -j
validation.result: All checked URLs returned HTTP 200, included Sourcey markers, linked github.com/sourcey/moxygen, and showed generated navigation terms.

documented_concepts: grouping modes for file-level and explicit Doxygen groups
observations: Ecosystem: TypeScript / Node.js npm CLI and library, distinct from the Go and C++ Sourcey docs proofs previously visible in accepted Frantic work.
License: MIT, confirmed from both package.json and LICENCE.
Adapter/config: docs/sourcey.config.ts uses Sourcey defineConfig(), markdown() groups, repo/edit links, prettyUrls strip, and GitHub/npm navbar links.
Command/config evidence: docs/package.json exposes site:build as `sourcey build -o ../dist`; package.json exposes moxygen as an npm binary and typed module.
Page list: Introduction, Quickstart, Writing Doxygen, CLI Reference, Programmatic API, Custom Templates, and Grouping Modes.
Public URL: https://0state.com/moxygen/docs returned HTTP 200 and included generated navigation plus a Sourcey build marker.
Durable host: the docs are on 0state.com/moxygen/docs and linked from the moxygen project/product page, not a personal or throwaway host.
Gaps: the live site emphasizes guide/config/API usage pages and source edit links; it is not a full TypeScript symbol-reference tab.
